name: Main Street, Stoneyford
agent: Walter Walsh Auctioneers & Valuers, Mill Street, Thomastown
questions: What is the floor area, and can you send a floor plan or room dimensions? Which rooms are on the ground floor?
Is there a guide price or an expected range, and what has interest been like so far?
How big is the rear garden (length, width or acreage), how wide is the side access, and is there any rear access or lane?

BuyerIQ maps a river flood zone about 90 m away: has the house or garden ever flooded, and is it insured now? Is the house in an Architectural Conservation Area or on the Record of Protected Structures?
What does the BER certificate (119858942) give in kWh/m²/yr, what heating is there now, and is there a recent survey of the roof, walls and damp?

ai.why: A semi-detached house on Stoneyford's main street needing major renovation, with a large but unmeasured rear garden: no acre, an attached neighbour, and size and price unknown. The walkable village, school 200 m away, mains services and Kilkenny's ED about 20 minutes away keep it as a wildcard.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; the listing says 'all mains services', but a house needing major renovation may need rewiring.

water.detail: Mains water: the listing says 'all mains services'.

sewer.detail: Mains sewer, from 'all mains services' in a village main street; confirm the connection on survey.

internet.detail: Fibre likely: not in the listing, but NBI's Thomastown deployment area names Stoneyford, and open eir may also serve the village. Check by Eircode.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Not confirmed: the listing names a kitchen, sitting room and dining room with three bedrooms and no floor plan, so the bedrooms are probably upstairs; the dining room could convert, and a full renovation could redesign the ground floor with a bedroom and shower room.

bedsNote: Three bedrooms, probably upstairs; the dining room is the likely downstairs conversion
tagline: A three-bed semi needing major renovation on the main street of Stoneyford, a small village between Kilkenny and Thomastown, with a large rear garden.

pros.detail: The listing puts the primary school 200 m away; Stoneyford (pop. 376 in 2016) has a Londis, a café, a takeaway and Malzards, Irish Pub of the Year 2024.

pros.text: Likely well under budget, all in (rough)
pros.detail: Price on application; a small stone house on the same street sold for €170k in Jan 2026, so a rough €150–220k to buy plus €150–250k to renovate would total about €300–470k.

pros.text: A renovation can be designed around the brief
pros.detail: With 'major renovations' needed anyway, the ground floor can be replanned for a parents' bedroom and shower room, or extended into the large rear garden.
St Luke's (24-hour ED, paediatric ward) is about 14 km straight-line; the listing's '8 km from Kilkenny City' is short: the city centre is about 13 km.
St Kieran's (boys, 100% progression in the 2023 report) and Kilkenny College (mixed, fee-paying) are about 13 km away; Grennan College in Thomastown is about 6 km.
The listing says 'all mains services': no well or septic tank to manage, which suits rental use.

pros.text: Mount Juliet and the King's River nearby
pros.detail: Mount Juliet (Lady Helen, Michelin star; The Hound) is about 4 km; the King's River is under 500 m from the village for dog walks.
About 7–8 Dublin trains a weekday, about 1h50 to Heuston; Kilkenny MacDonagh is about 13 km.
Price set on 8 Oct 2026 (was price on application); with a rough €150–250k renovation that is about €350–450k all-in.

cons.detail: An attached neighbour and street frontage on the village's main road: little space around the house (not checked from above; the listing has one photo).
Only 'a large garden to the rear', size not given; a village main-street plot is typically well under a quarter of an acre.
The listing says 'in need of major renovations'; BER E with no kWh figure and no heating stated. A full renovation is a rough €150–250k and 12–18 months before it's liveable.
No m² or room sizes given; a three-bed village semi may well be under the 100 m² floor without an extension.
No floor plan; the downstairs rooms listed are a kitchen, sitting room and dining room.

cons.text: Mapped flood zone about 90 m away
cons.detail: BuyerIQ shows a moderate river flood zone about 90 m from the address; two streams run through the village to the King's River.
One photo, no floor plan and no aerial check yet; BuyerIQ flags one critical and three high-priority items behind its paywall, and 10 planning applications within 1 km.
